these are 5mm screws not 3mm like those for the rest of the chassis.

if you have issues mounting the door, check so you dont have a shorter screw by misstake.
i was smart enough to put the screws next to the door

y'know... you keep telling me i removed something earlier. but, damned if i know when or where those went. it's not really useful -- it'd be more useful if you told me when i removed them to keep them with the thing or something....
If you screwed them into the door hinges like I did earlier, don't forget that ...you did that.
